observations.why: Imperative verb enacts a command structure — speaker directs the audience to discard knowledge, a rank-based allocation of what may be retained.
Direct imperative to excise specific knowledge from the record — authority-ranking enacted through command over what the audience must purge.
Declarative assertion issued as authoritative correction of the record — speaker asserts institutional fact from a position of epistemic authority, supporting the directive to remove.

mints.name: DirectiveKnowledgeExcision
mints.title: command to remove specified knowledge from the record
mints.frame: Is the speaker exercising authority by directing what knowledge the audience must discard, rather than merely describing what to do?
